summary: Executor now classifies post-agent git add/commit failures with four structured reason codes (POST_AGENT_GIT_ADD_FAILED, POST_AGENT_COMMIT_FAILED, POST_AGENT_COMMIT_PRECOMMIT_FAILED, POST_AGENT_COMMIT_FORMAT_REWRITE_NEEDED), preserves agent_run_reason_code (e.g. AGENT_IDLE_TIMEOUT) when the commit step fails after a non-zero agent exit, and runs a scoped ruff format repair restricted to the intersection of staged paths and Would reformat: paths. TDD coverage lands first: tests/unit/control/test_executor_post_agent_commit_classifier.py (6 cases), tests/unit/control/test_executor_post_agent_commit.py (7 cases — precommit/format/retry-failed/skipped-intersection/idle-timeout-preserved/git-add/generic), updated TestCommitStepRuntimeError assertion to POST_AGENT_COMMIT_FAILED, and a pre-commit hook stability regression. REASON_CATALOG.md gains the four new entries with operator fixes. PR #236 terminal runtime cleanup files (src/awf/control/worker.py, src/awf/service/orphan_resources.py) are untouched; the new workspace.post_agent_commit_format_repair event is non-terminal so the runtime-release sweep's idempotency check is unaffected.
